name: gateway_run_collect_history_media_paths
notes: History media-path dedup collection. Harness is a traced copy of run_pure2.c::gw_collect_history_media_paths (libjson-linked); twin drives the LIVE gateway/run.py::_collect_history_media_paths. V events use canonical sorted order because the C port preserves first-seen order while LIVE returns a set. Outcome-level ladder only (B1 non-array, per-path V, joined V): LIVE additionally scans assistant-role messages and image_generate JSON payloads through extract_media; the C port scans only tool/function message text with a naive token scan. DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCES (inputs excluded): assistant-role MEDIA text paths, JSON-payload host_image/image/agent_visible_image fields, relative or extension-less tokens longer than 4 chars, quoted/spaced path shapes that extract_media accepts and the token scan does not. Gated inputs are tool/function-only with extension-anchored absolute paths where both sides agree on the deduped set.
